title.narrative: APPS: Danish support to the African Union Peace Fund Secretariat (2026-2028)

description.narrative: The objective of the development cooperation is to contribute to sustainable peace and security in Africa by strengthening the AUPF’s institutional capacity and enhancing its access to predictable and transparent ODA-compliant funding mechanisms. This objective will be pursued through two mutually reinforcing outcomes: 1. The institutional capacity of the AUPF Secretariat is enhanced to strengthen its ODA-compliant strategic planning, coordination, monitoring, resource mobilization, and international partners’ engagement. This outcome focuses on consolidating the AUPF’s internal institutional foundations to ensure effective management and stewardship of resources. 2. Improved access to predictable and transparent ODA-compliant financing: The AUPF benefits from more predictable, transparent, and timely access to ODA-compliant donor financing to support peacebuilding and conflict prevention initiatives. This outcome reflects the external impact of the strengthened institutional capacity—namely, an expanded and predictable allocation of resources in support of Africa’s peace and security agenda.
